scope: DXF DIMENSION callback conversion of documented OCS point fields when dxfRW::read explicitly requests applyExtrusion; no physical-source or support claim

authority.title: Autodesk Common Dimension Group Codes (DXF)
rules: Group 210/220/230 supplies the extrusion direction used for the entity OCS.

authority.title: Autodesk Object Coordinate Systems (DXF)
authority.rule: The OCS basis is computed from the extrusion normal using the arbitrary-axis algorithm.

behavior: DRW_Dimension::applyExtrusion converts textPoint, clonePoint and arcPoint through the existing arbitrary-axis basis when an extrusion normal is present.
WCS definition points are not modified.
processDimension applies this conversion only when dxfRW::read(..., applyExtrusion=true), before dispatching the typed dimension callback.
The default false option retains the parsed native OCS/WCS point frames.

generatedControl.applyExtrusionFalse: Both callbacks retain their original OCS text/clone/arc points.
generatedControl.preservationControl: The test checks WCS points and normal unchanged, plus linear group-50/group-51 and angular group-51 values retained.
generatedControl.fixtureDisposition: Generated in a temporary directory by the test and deleted; no DWG/DXF fixture committed.

limitations: Generated parser/callback controls only; no physical producer or paired-source evidence was used.
No native LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD or other consumer dimension-display check was performed.
Only linear and two-line angular typed callbacks are covered; other dimension subtype placement and rendered text behavior remain unqualified.
This does not promote a format-support claim.
